label: Treccia di Santa Croce di Magliano

about.text: A Molisan pasta filata cheese made mainly in Santa Croce di Magliano, with a texture like scamorza. The curd is covered in boiling whey and then boiling water, pulled into strands and hand-braided into a flat braid.
